info.name: The Discount Window — machine surface
info.description: The read-only JSON surface of the Discount Window, matching docs/openapi.yaml. Import this collection, run the server (`npm start`), and read the book the way an agent would: no screen-scraping, no secrets, and no way to move money from here — that is the point. The desk-only routes use basic auth with username `desk`; on a public demo, use the password the README names.

variable.description: Basic auth for desk:thesharedpassword — replace with the deployed demo's password. On localhost with no password configured, the desk needs no header at all.

request.description: Open to everyone: the audit chain re-walked on every call. If ok is false, the book has been tampered with and says so.
Aggregate vitals with no login: chain integrity, book counts, ledger balances, webhook summary.
Every invoice with score, band, price and status. Add ?status=REFUSED for the refusal archive as data.
Replace the id with one from The book. Returns the eleven checks, the score, the price, the slices, the audit chain and the extraction — the whole deal room as an object.
Double-entry postings by transaction, account totals, and the last twenty webhooks PayPal delivered — with their signature verdicts.

No basic auth on this route — its authority is PayPal's signature check. This forged event is stored with verified=0 and changes nothing: the answer is 'unverified, stored'. Send it twice: the replay is answered 'duplicate'.
